title: JMAP Chat.name ignores RoomMetaData language tags; choose descriptions by language_tag and Accept-Language
description: Sweep 2026-11-14. crates/mimid-server/src/hub/mod.rs:400-419 and jmap/projection.rs:270-286 take Chat.name from RoomMetaData.room_name only; room_descriptions[].language_tag (mimi-protocol/src/component.rs:84) is never used. When descriptions are projected, pick by language_tag against the client's Accept-Language. Also low: JMAP invalidArguments descriptions (projection.rs) and problem titles (auth.rs:34,37) are English; RFC 8620 means them for developers, fine as long as clients key on type.
notes: 2026-11-14: blocked on the JMAP Chat draft, which has no language model at all (jmap-chat-spec bead filed the same day: locale/localizations after RFC 8984). Implement what that settles; don't invent an Accept-Language rule in mimid.
close_reason: Implemented per draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00: i18n capability, Chat name/description localizations from RoomMetaData, language arg with RFC 4647 Lookup. Chat applicability per jmap-chat-spec-qb21 (open); revisit if qb21's table changes.
